record.paper_title: Collective Phenomena in the LiHoxY1−xF4 Quantum Ising Magnet: Recent Progress and Open Questions
record.original_question: Can comparative studies of other highly diluted Ising magnetic materials, including diluted spin-ice compounds (DyxY1−x)2Ti2O7 and (HoxY1−x)2Ti2O7 and proposed transverse-field Ising materials HoxY1−x(OH)3 and DyxY1−x(OH)3, clarify the physics responsible for the high-dilution behavior of LiHoxY1−xF4?

evidence.quote: Perhaps the study of other highly diluted Ising magnetic materials could help shed some light on the physics at play in LiHoxY1−xF4.

In this context, a study of the highly diluted Ising spin ice materials (DyxY1−x)2Ti2O7 and (HoxY1−x)2Ti2O7 [81] as well as the proposed HoxY1−x(OH)3 and DyxY1−x(OH)3 TFIM materials [38] to compare with LiHoxY1−xF4 could prove interesting and instructive.

artifact.status_search_result: A literature check indicates that the nature of the low-temperature phase of highly diluted LiHo_xY_{1-x}F_4 (spin glass vs. antiglass vs. trivial paramagnet) remains under active debate, with conflicting experimental and theoretical results published since 2011. The proposed comparative program with dilute pyrochlore spin ices and dilute rare-earth hydroxide TFIMs has not produced a definitive resolution; no consensus answer has been established.

status_evidence.title: LiHoxY1-xF4 spin glass debate
status_evidence.snippet: Review notes that the nature of the highly dilute regime in LiHoxY1-xF4 remains an open question and suggests comparative studies as a possible avenue.
status_evidence.claim: The high-dilution behavior of LiHoxY1-xF4 is unresolved and proposed comparative studies have not yet settled it.
